message.content:
Below are two ways to create a **Compute Engine** instance that has an **NVIDIA RTX A6000** GPU and boots from **Ubuntu 20.04 LTS**.

> **NOTE**  
> *Google Cloud does not use “EC2”; that is an AWS term.  
> The examples below use the Compute Engine API (the Google equivalent).  
> Make sure you have the Compute Engine API enabled, a project with a GPU quota for `nvidia-a6000`, and that you’re authenticated (e.g., `gcloud auth application‑default login`).*

---

## 1.  `gcloud` CLI

```bash
# Variables – change these to match your environment
PROJECT="my-gcp-project"
ZONE="us-central1-a"          # pick a zone that supports RTX A6000
INSTANCE_NAME="rtx-a6000-ubuntu"

# Create the instance
gcloud compute instances create "$INSTANCE_NAME" \
  --project="$PROJECT" \
  --zone="$ZONE" \
  --machine-type="n1-standard-8" \
  --accelerator="type=nvidia-a6000,count=1" \
  --image-family="ubuntu-2004-lts" \
  --image-project="ubuntu-os-cloud" \
  --boot-disk-size="100GB" \
  --boot-disk-type="pd-ssd" \
  --metadata="install-nvidia-driver=true,nvidia-driver-version=470" \
  --tags="http-server,https-server" \
  --scopes="https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"
```

### What the command does

| Flag | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `--machine-type` | CPU & RAM (here 8 vCPU / 30 GB RAM) |
| `--accelerator` | Adds one RTX A6000 GPU |
| `--image-family` / `--image-project` | Ubuntu 20.04 LTS image |
| `--boot-disk-size` / `--boot-disk-type` | SSD boot disk, 100 GB |
| `--metadata` | Installs the NVIDIA driver automatically (`470` is the latest stable at the time of writing) |
| `--tags` | Opens ports 80/443 (optional) |
| `--scopes` | Gives the instance full Cloud Platform access (needed for driver install) |

> **GPU driver installation**  
> The `install-nvidia-driver=true` metadata key tells the Ubuntu image to run the NVIDIA driver installer on first boot.  
> If you need a different driver version, change `nvidia-driver-version`.

---

## 2.  REST API (curl)

```bash
# Variables – change these to match your environment
PROJECT="my-gcp-project"
ZONE="us-central1-a"
INSTANCE_NAME="rtx-a6000-ubuntu"
ACCESS_TOKEN=$(gcloud auth print-access-token)

# JSON payload
read -r -d '' INSTANCE_JSON <<EOF
{
  "name": "$INSTANCE_NAME",
  "machineType": "zones/$ZONE/machineTypes/n1-standard-8",
  "disks": [
    {
      "boot": true,
      "autoDelete": true,
      "initializeParams": {
        "sourceImage": "projects/ubuntu-os-cloud/global/images/family/ubuntu-2004-lts",
        "diskSizeGb": 100,
        "diskType": "projects/$PROJECT/zones/$ZONE/diskTypes/pd-ssd"
      }
    }
  ],
  "networkInterfaces": [
    {
      "network": "global/networks/default",
      "accessConfigs": [
        { "type": "ONE_TO_ONE_NAT", "name": "External NAT" }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "guestAccelerators": [
    {
      "acceleratorType": "projects/$PROJECT/zones/$ZONE/acceleratorTypes/nvidia-a6000",
      "acceleratorCount": 1
    }
  ],
  "serviceAccounts": [
    {
      "email": "default",
      "scopes": ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"]
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "items": [
      { "key": "install-nvidia-driver", "value": "true" },
      { "key": "nvidia-driver-version", "value": "470" }
    ]
  },
  "tags": { "items": ["http-server", "https-server"] },
  "description": "Ubuntu 20.04 LTS with RTX A6000 GPU"
}
EOF

# POST request
curl -X POST \
  "https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/$PROJECT/zones/$ZONE/instances" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$INSTANCE_JSON"
```

### Explanation of the JSON

| Field | Meaning |
|-------|---------|
| `name` | Instance name |
| `machineType` | CPU/RAM configuration |
| `disks[0]` | Boot disk (Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, 100 GB SSD) |
| `networkInterfaces[0]` | Default VPC, external IP |
| `guestAccelerators[0]` | One RTX A6000 GPU |
| `serviceAccounts[0]` | Default service account with full Cloud Platform scope |
| `metadata.items` | Installs NVIDIA driver (`470`) on first boot |
| `tags.items` | Opens ports 80/443 (optional) |
| `description` | Human‑readable description |

---

## Quick Checklist

| ✅ | Item |
|----|------|
| ✅ | Compute Engine API enabled |
| ✅ | Project has GPU quota for `nvidia-a6000` |
| ✅ | Zone supports RTX A6000 (e.g., `us-central1-a`, `us-east1-b`, etc.) |
| ✅ | Authenticated (`gcloud auth application-default login` or service‑account key) |
| ✅ | Optional: open firewall rules for SSH/HTTP/HTTPS if needed |

Once the instance is running, you can SSH into it and verify the GPU:

```bash
ssh ubuntu@$INSTANCE_NAME
nvidia-smi
```

You should see the RTX A6000 listed with the installed driver.
